init.description: Initialize the customer workspace and inspect connection readiness.
init.instructions: Configure the operator and authorized accounts, create or reuse the clean Aimore structure and pilot settings, and report readiness. Use supplied context and saved settings; ask only for missing actual values. Do not enable/create schedules, send messages, or run live CRM write/send acceptance tests from this command. Return setup, missing-input and next-test links.

add-communication.description: Add a communication for review; the shared queue resumes submitted work.
add-communication.instructions: Manually initiate a communication intake with Mode=Manual provenance. Accept authorized source content, a message or transcript. Prepare matching/data/Notes-persona review and stop before unapproved CRM changes. The operator submits in Notion; run-auto or the native queue observes and validates the current submission, then resumes the exact unfinished owner step without a continue command. Existing legacy continuation syntax may still be understood for compatibility, but never require or recommend it. Preserve source, task/run IDs and Mode; no customer sends from this intake command.

run-auto.description: Discover inputs once; exit idle immediately or process affected ready work.
run-auto.instructions: FIRST read only registered RunSettings and call scan.entry BEFORE discovery, EventIndex/watch/task queries, invocation/run/log records or owner preflight. ScanStopped ends quietly with no other workflow operations or writes. ScanControlUnknown means no scanning or mutation, not auto-init. Only ScanEnabled proceeds. FIRST use event-discovery.md and local scan.probe over current scoped changes and due indexes, before business inference, owner preflights, CRM/source-content/preview checks or routine Dashboard writes. ScanIdle ends immediately after necessary compact index persistence; ScanDiscoveryRequired retries only missing coverage within budget. New mail/replies, actual form submissions, controls/source changes and due timers are events; unchanged waits are not. Only ScanWorkReady enters the bounded affected queue. Run ONE bounded queue cycle under one-cycle-approved-work. Scan authorized Gmail and available SMS reply/stop sources first, then current Notion task/action submissions, due follow-up records, relevant configured Dropbox source/version changes and due internal reminders/confirmed Calendar work. Discover Automatic tasks plus manually initiated communication tasks with submitted current review/data; keep Mode as provenance, not a second continue gate. Observe forms before acceptance, persist the bound accepted submission, then dispatch only each recorded owner step. Use queue-execution.md to enqueue newly ready successors in this same cycle, without recursively restarting scanners or sleeping until future due times. Exact content/preview/version approval remains required for emails and CRM fact changes. Factual SMS notifications use current standing notification-sms-v1 authority: generate/edit, freeze and send when due without per-message ContentReview/SendApproval or a second chat question. Keep stop/pause, invocation no-send restrictions, time/count/channel/attempt checks. Do not create/enable schedules, guess sources, send commercial offers as notifications or replay unknown provider effects. Return actual outcomes, original links, waiting/future/blocked counts and partial coverage. No scheduler management tools or create/list/read capability discovery is required for this deliberate one-cycle command. No unique executor, assigned conversation, host/thread/turn identity, native invocation ID or global serialization/activity proof is required. Use task-state-v2 and a local RunId for logs only; recheck each exact task/step/version and original attempt before effects. Ignore historical executor assignment settings without requiring init/rebinding. Always recover original pending events even when discovery revisions are unchanged. Recover saved-source handoffs through backlog.recover; baseline gaps cannot globally block independent draft work. Record cycle.metrics with concrete no-progress blocks. Actual native wakes instead use scheduled-entry.md directly, loading current_rules.py afresh.

report.description: Update and show the current daily action report with original task links.
report.instructions: Upsert the daily brief for the configured business timezone and show pending review/approval/follow-up/submitted-intake tasks, important-reminder state and actual failures with original links. Treat this as a report invocation, not a scheduled reminder run: do not send notifications or customer messages, create/change Calendar events, resume tasks, write CRM business data or run handover rehearsals. Read existing records and write only the report and required operational logs. Missing optional sources remain visible as incomplete coverage, not invented success. Freeze actual report/run/log target IDs at entry and preflight every mutation under notion-publishing.md. Quality recovery cannot edit tasks/actions/hub/previews/Health or call their owners from report. Describe outside-scope findings with a separate next owner command; audit actual writes at exit. Before Completed/final Success, typed saved-page checks and current completion-gate evidence are required; do not accept skipped entities, failed exits or stale evidence.

reply-draft.description: Prepare a source-backed sales reply and matching Notion preview for approval.
reply-draft.instructions: Use supplied authorized inquiry/message/task or registered action-page context and configured Dropbox sources. New inquiry-reply tasks use Mode=Automatic; this command remains draft-only. Prepare/edit copy, source/version evidence, stored draft and matching preview; validate content decisions only and create the separate SendApproval, then stop without sending. A registered current action URL is sufficient context; no continue subcommand is required. Preserve legacy Manual tasks as Manual rather than enrolling them. After content/send submission, point eligible queue work to the next verified native tick or the public run-auto command; never print a private owner command. Do not consume send approval, send, or start SMS from draft-only. Missing facts/identity/preview remain pending.

start.description: Enable scanning; leave periodic tasks unchanged.
start.instructions: Operation=start. Read only actual registered RunSettings. Run scan.control-plan and patch only scan_control.enabled=true under scan-control-v1, preserving all other settings and business/native task records. Repeat with the same flag is a no-op. Read back and run scan.control-verify before claiming Scanning enabled. No native scheduler discovery/list/create/update/pause/delete, cadence change, workflow plan/run/log creation, immediate scan, task processing or send. Legacy interval_minutes arguments do not change scheduling. Missing settings reports a setup limitation without automatically initializing. On explicit start reuse and read the registered existing native task where the host supports readback; pass native_observation to scan.control-plan and register actual configuration separately from scanning enabled and live business progress. Never create duplicates. Missing management access is a registration limitation only, not an execution gate. Preserve real concurrent stop/revocation.

stop.description: Disable scanning; leave periodic tasks unchanged.
stop.instructions: Operation=stop. Read only actual registered RunSettings. Run scan.control-plan and patch only scan_control.enabled=false, preserving all other settings, tasks, decisions, cursors, approvals, provider attempts and native jobs. Repeat is a no-op. Verify actual saved settings before Scanning stopped. Do not query/create/update/pause/delete any automation, scan business data, create workflow logs or send. Subsequent manual/periodic run-auto only reads this switch and exits quietly. A running cycle stops before its next admission; persist only the original result of an already in-flight effect.
